description: Live status for today only (Japan time, Asia/Tokyo): not_started 未出勤 / working 勤務中 / on_break 休憩中 / finished 退勤済み, minutes worked so far (breaks excluded), break minutes, and today's punches. No arguments; "today" is never a date you pass. Call this immediately before punch to see which type is legal. For the end-of-day checklist (short breaks, man-hours, overtime, alerts), use close_out scope=day instead of chaining tools. Not 勤務処理 labels such as 欠勤 or 出張 — that admin tool is get_working_treatments.
name: get_today_status
title: Get today's work status
